title: periods.terminate
description: Outcome of a termination request per subscription status (BE-SP-54..56); error subscription_canceled for a canceled one.

timezone.description: Effective time zone of the customer (BE-DM-10).

next_subscription_status.description: Status of the successor after the request; present only when subscription.next_subscription is not none.

previous_subscription_status.description: Status of the predecessor after the request; present only when previous_subscription is given. The op's predecessor is terminated (it ended when this subscription started) and no termination request changes it, so the value is terminated.
